title: NLinear: A simple NLinear baseline matches or exceeds contemporary transformer forecasters on ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using NLinear, a normalization linear baseline. On ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity, at horizon 720, A simple NLinear baseline matches or exceeds contemporary transformer forecasters on ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity. NLinear achieved lower average MSE than five transformer baselines across 3 datasets at horizon 720. We discuss two limitations: Confidence intervals or standard errors are not reported for the headline metric. Missing-value handling is delegated to preprocessing and not stress-tested. Future work should address combining channel-independent tokenisation with variate-token attention. and reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
